articles.headline: UEFA VP: Gianni Infantino World Cup plan 'struck at the heart of the game'
articles.description: Gianni Infantino's plan to sell off a stake in the World Cup "struck at the very heart of the principles of the game," UEFA vice-president Laura McAllister has told ESPN.

articles.headline: Barcelona president Joan Laporta says Camp Nou should host 2030 World Cup final
articles.description: Barcelona president Joan Laporta has argued that the Camp Nou should host the 2030 World Cup final.

articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: England boss Thomas Tuchel defends subs vs. Argentina: 'It's my scar'
articles.description: England boss Thomas Tuchel said he stands by his heavily criticised defensive substitutions in the World Cup semifinal defeat to Argentina, but accepts he made them too early.

articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel: 'Regret I didn't eat some grass' after England's Azteca win over Mexico
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has revealed he wished he had eaten some of the grass after England's memorable FIFA World Cup win over Mexico.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi called up for Oct. 6 Argentina friendly for 'last tango'
articles.description: Despite announcing his international retirement, Lionel Messi was included Tuesday in Argentina's squad for a farewell friendly against Benin on Oct. 6.
